reason: Core 0.5.0's document-manifest and evaluation-manifest schemas name a supported extension with the Core schema's extension-name pattern and its not, in place of a lookahead, so a name ending in a line terminator is refused in every engine (issue #308, RFC 0031); under ECMA-262 the two forms admit the same names. The document-manifest schema's expectedDiagnostics description names every finding a case gives.
